text.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

words.gloss_range: reported collective saying that introduces a completed quoted response; local force is public confession rather than private thought, command, dispute, or fabrication
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, and expression of meaning; other derived dispute or fabrication branches remain contrastive rather than selected by this simple perfect form
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا}} ({{tr:qālū}}) turns the group's recognition into a completed public utterance. Its perfect active plural form keeps the garden owners as accountable speakers, while the following quote remains one speech frame that contains both praise and confession. The word also answers the prior rebuke (68:28): those who were addressed now speak together, so admonition becomes self-accusation. Wider speech-confession echoes matter as structure, especially the repentance formula associated with 21:87 and the garden narrative's later speech at 68:31, but the local form remains the plain act of saying rather than a dispute or fabrication branch. The opening long-vowel cadence makes that collective admission audible as the ayah begins.

topics.headline: completed public speech frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confession is not narrator commentary or private recognition but a completed public saying by the group.
topics.reason: The local verb is a perfect active 3mp reporting predicate with a quoted complement spanning the rest of the ayah.

topics.headline: plural morphology bears accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers are carried by the verb's plural morphology, so the group itself bears the confession without needing a repeated noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a pro-drop 3mp subject resolved to the same group addressed in the surrounding scene.

topics.headline: rebuke becomes reply
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from being reproached in 68:28 to answering with their own confession in 68:29.
topics.reason: The context-window support identifies 68:28 as the triggering admonition, and the local speech verb introduces the answer.

topics.headline: one quote contains praise and confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that praise and self-blame are not detached sayings but two beats inside one reported response.
topics.reason: The quoted complement governed by the speech verb runs from the praise formula through the full emphatic confession.

topics.headline: formula echoes without replacing local speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local speech act participates in a wider confession pattern while remaining this group's own plural answer.
topics.reason: Rows point to 21:87, the same-surah speech chain, and 68:31; these are valid echoes, but they function as parallels and staging rather than as a different local parse.

topics.headline: opening cadence of admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening speech verb begins the ayah's measured public-admission cadence.
topics.reason: The row is a concrete sound observation tied to the positioned surface form and the ayah's following cadence.

words.gloss_range: compressed declaration of divine transcendence in an accusative maṣdar formula, bound to the following Lord relation and answering the previously missing glorification
words.root_gloss_range: movement, free motion, swimming or floating, and declaring transcendence; local grammar selects the theological glorification formula while retaining movement-beyond-limitation pressure
words.prose: {{ar:سُبْحَٰنَ}} ({{tr:subḥāna}}) is a compressed maṣdar performance of glorification, not a loose exclamation. Its construct relation binds the praise to the following Lord relation, so the first beat performs the act that 68:28 had exposed as missing. The root's motion image survives as theological pressure: the selected sense is declaring divine transcendence, while the background image makes that declaration feel like removing God beyond every limiting attribution. The word also opens the praise-before-confession order and links the local recovery to the confession pattern of 21:87, now in a plural communal setting. Its length and sibilant-to-breathy sound give the compact formula audible room at the start of the quoted content.

topics.headline: compressed glorification act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word performs glorification through a compact verbal-noun construction rather than merely naming a pious interjection.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as an accusative maṣdar formula with an implicit governing glorification act.

topics.headline: praise bound to its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the praise is not unanchored; the construct form binds it to the Lord relation named next.
topics.reason: The local iḍāfa relation syntactically forces the following noun as the genitive complement of the praise formula.

topics.headline: motion image becomes transcendence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the theological declaration carries a movement-beyond-limitation image, while local grammar keeps glorification as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root range can support motion imagery, but the local maṣdar formula and divine complement select the declaration of transcendence.

topics.headline: missing glorification becomes uttered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 68:29 answers 68:28 by turning the previously missing glorification into the first spoken content.
topics.reason: The source rows give the concrete 68:28 to 68:29 transition, and local syntax places this word first inside the quote.

topics.headline: confession formula echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the link with the 21:87 confession pattern, while the local ayah makes the formula collective rather than solitary.
topics.reason: The rows provide the concrete 21:87 comparison, and the local wording preserves the glorification-confession architecture with changed speaker number.

topics.headline: praise opens the quote audibly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote begins with divine transcendence before self-accusation, and the compact formula is given audible weight.
topics.reason: The word is the first item of quoted content, carries recitational length, and sets the first beat before the confession beat.

words.gloss_range: our Lord, with possessive relation and governing-sustaining authority foregrounded inside the praise formula
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, nurturing, governing, bringing to completion, and related increase pressure; local sense selects the singular relational Lord-Sustainer
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbinā}}) closes the praise beat on relationship: not an abstract divine title, but their singular Lord-Sustainer over the group. The genitive construct binds it to the glorification formula, and the attached first-person plural suffix brings the same speakers into the title at the moment they confess. The root's nurturing and governing field is locally important because the garden story concerns provision and growth under a sustaining order; the increase association sharpens that irony but does not replace the Lord-Sustainer sense. The word also pivots the ayah from divine perfection to human fault, pairing the invoked Lord relation with the final wrongdoing predicate. Later surah echoes at 68:32 and 68:49 keep that Lord-relation active through confession, hope, and rescue. The geminated b gives the compact title audible weight before the pronoun releases into their collective relation.

topics.headline: our Lord as confessed relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers do not invoke a generic title; they place themselves inside the relation by saying their Lord.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is syntactically attached to the noun and resolved to the same speaking group.

topics.headline: construct binds praise to Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the praise formula is grammatically anchored to the Lord relation rather than floating as a detached exclamation.
topics.reason: The word is the genitive complement after the praise formula, making it the relation named inside the act of glorification.

topics.headline: nurturing governance with increase irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Lordship is felt as sustaining governance over growth, while the increase association sharpens the garden owners' irony without changing the local title.
topics.reason: The local noun names the Lord-Sustainer, while root-family growth and increase evidence is valid as pressure because the surrounding narrative concerns provision and garden gain.

topics.headline: singular authority over the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one singular sustaining authority over the group, not a pluralized or indefinite lordship.
topics.reason: The local form is a singular construct noun with possessive definiteness and a divine referent profile.

topics.headline: relation pivots to fault
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first beat lands on relation before the next beat names the speakers' moral fault.
topics.reason: The word closes the praise beat immediately before the emphatic confession clause begins.

topics.headline: surah-local Lord thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confessed Lord relation continues into later surah movement, including hope for replacement at 68:32 and rescue-language at 68:49.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah references, so the echo is retained as a local thread rather than a new sense.

topics.headline: compact weighted title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact sound weight in the title before the pronoun releases into collective relation.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the geminated consonant in the positioned surface form.

words.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle fused with first-person plural self-reference, opening the confessed past-state predicate
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) begins the second beat by making the admission asserted rather than tentative. Its fused particle and first-person plural pronoun lock emphasis to the speakers themselves, so the wrongdoing is not a general human possibility but their own claim about themselves. The particle scopes over the full past-state confession that follows, organizing it as an asserted identity statement rather than a bare event report. Positioned after the praise beat, it turns divine transcendence into explanation: because the Lord is beyond fault, the fault is located in the speakers. Its nasal echo with the following past-state verb gives the self-confession a tight audible link.

topics.headline: asserted confession scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the admission is presented as certain self-knowledge, not as hesitation or possibility.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following predicate content and opens the emphatic confession clause.

topics.headline: emphasis fused to we
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emphasis and collective self-reference are inseparable in the surface form.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the suffix as the governed subject of the particle and resolves it to the speakers.

topics.headline: praise turns into diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural turn from praising divine perfection to naming the speakers' own moral diagnosis.
topics.reason: The particle begins the second quoted clause immediately after the praise formula.

topics.headline: nasal link to past-state verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that assertion, self-reference, and the following past-state verb are audibly tied together.
topics.reason: The sound row is tied to the repeated doubled nasal pattern across adjacent surface forms inside the same clause.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural perfect copula marking an established past moral state and carrying the speakers into the final predicate
words.root_gloss_range: being, existence, becoming, and statehood; local form selects copular past-state predication, while broader creation-command associations remain contrastive pressure only

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle fused with first-person plural self-reference

words.prose: {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) makes the confession about what the speakers had been, not a single newly reported deed. As a perfect copular auxiliary, it gives tense and statehood while leaving the moral content to the final predicate. Its first-person plural form repeats the collective self-reference after {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}), carrying the asserted we into the state they name. The doubled n and long ā shared with {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) make emphatic assertion and past being sound like one linked unit before the moral label arrives. The broad being-root can evoke existence and the creation-command contrast, but locally that pressure is narrowed to human moral state, not creative command. The construction also belongs to a recognizable being-plus-wrongdoing confession pattern, with 21:87 as a singular parallel and 68:31 as a same-surah escalation from wronging to transgression.

topics.headline: wrongdoing as past state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confession names an established past condition rather than a one-time event.
topics.reason: The verb is a perfect copular auxiliary with the active participle as its predicate.

topics.headline: tense separated from moral content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the auxiliary supplies the state frame while the following predicate supplies the moral label.
topics.reason: The local relation marks the final active participle as the predicate governed by this copular verb.

topics.headline: we carried into the state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same collective speakers are fused into the state verb, leaving little room to deflect agency.
topics.reason: The first-person plural morphology supplies the subject and matches the preceding emphatic pronoun.

topics.headline: being-root as moral existence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the being-root makes the confession existential in feel, while local grammar narrows it to human moral state rather than a creative command.
topics.reason: The root range supports being and existence, but the local perfect copula with a moral predicate selects state predication.

topics.headline: recognizable state-confession pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recognizable formula of being plus moral predicate, moving from the singular confession of 21:87 to the group's confession here and the escalation at 68:31.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete comparisons to 21:87 and 68:31, while the local attachment confirms the same copular predicate structure.

topics.headline: nasal cadence binds assertion and being
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the emphatic assertion and the past-state verb sound like a linked unit before the moral label arrives.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows are tied to adjacent clause-internal forms and the shift into self-confession.

words.gloss_range: active plural wrongdoers as the final predicate of the past-state confession, assigning agency and moral misplacement to the speakers
words.root_gloss_range: wrongdoing, injustice, putting something out of place, and darkness-related pressure; local active participle selects agentive wrongdoing while darkness remains image pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ظَٰلِمِينَ}} ({{tr:ẓālimīna}}) is the word where the confession lands. As an active plural participle and predicate of the past-state verb, it makes the speakers doers of wrong, not victims of circumstance or a merely abstract quality. The root image of misplacement gives the moral label texture: their failure is a disordering of rights and relation, while the darkness branch adds image pressure without replacing the active wrongdoing sense. The word also completes the two-beat contrast between the Lord they invoke and the wrong they assign to themselves. Its direct predicate form intensifies the comparison with 21:87, where the confession is partitive, and 68:31 later escalates the same state frame to transgression. Because it is final, its sound and meaning leave the ayah on collective self-indictment.

topics.headline: active wrongdoer predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final predicate assigns active wrongdoing to the speakers rather than portraying them as wronged or merely affected.
topics.reason: The local form is an active participle in the predicate slot of the copular verb, with plural agreement to the speakers.

topics.headline: plural class of agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural morphology makes the group collectively occupy the wrongdoer label.
topics.reason: The masculine sound plural accusative agrees with the plural speakers carried by the preceding copular verb.

topics.headline: misplacement with darkness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wrongdoing is pictured as moral misplacement, with darkness pressure sharpening the image while local grammar keeps active injustice as the selected predicate.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports misplacement and darkness-related imagery, but the local active participle predicate selects wrongdoer status.

topics.headline: Lord relation contrasted with misplacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah moves from the Lord relation of proper order to the speakers' confession of having displaced that order.
topics.reason: The local ayah places the Lord relation in the first beat and this wrongdoer predicate in the second beat.

topics.headline: direct predicate intensifies confession echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison with 21:87 is sharpened because this ayah uses direct predication rather than membership language.
topics.reason: The rows provide the concrete 21:87 comparison, and local syntax confirms this word as a direct predicate.

topics.headline: final self-indictment and later escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah withholds the moral label until the end, then 68:31 later escalates that same state frame.
topics.reason: The word completes the copular predicate at ayah end, and the source rows give the concrete same-surah escalation at 68:31.

topics.headline: terminal sound of self-blame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final sound leaves the self-assigned moral label resonating after the recitation stops.
topics.reason: The sound rows are tied to the positioned final surface form and its closing long-vowel-plus-nasal cadence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural utterance joins `subhana rabbina` directly to the emphatic `inna kunna zalimin`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying performs an attributional reversal: the Lord is cleared of defect and restored as owner-governor, while the speakers locate disorder in their own prior condition. The confession is therefore an act that reallocates agency, not only a report of regret.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies articulated speech; the plural verb makes recognition a shared and audible act.
The branch supplies clearing and absolution; it removes defect from the Lord before fault is reassigned.
The branch supplies ownership and governing authority; `our Lord` identifies the authority whose order their conduct displaced.
The branch supplies temporal predication; `we were` locates wrongdoing as a condition extended through prior time.
The branch supplies concrete mistiming or misplacement; it gives the self-accusation the mechanism of putting action outside its proper place and time.

changed_reading.before: They praise God and admit generic wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: They publicly transfer attribution: their Lord is cleared and their own former ordering of action is named as the source of wrong.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `Rabbina` and `zalimin` place a nurturing relation and a rights-withholding relation inside one sentence.
baseline_models.mechanism: One focus root presents lordship as cultivation, repair, and completion, while another presents wrong as holding someone back from a due. Their confession can therefore diagnose conduct that interrupted a nurturing circulation rather than merely violated an abstract rule.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies staged nurture and repair; it makes the Lord relation an order that brings lives and goods toward completion.
The branch supplies prevention and withheld right; it allows `wrongdoers` to name an obstructed due rather than undifferentiated guilt.
The branch supplies worship, thanks, and remembered praise; the formula reopens relation to the giver after an act of withholding.

changed_reading.before: Their confession is a general admission of moral failure.
changed_reading.after: Their confession may recognize that they blocked a due within an order meant to nurture and complete, making their wrong actively anti-nurturing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic clause says `we were wrongdoers`, not simply `we are wrongdoers`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance reclassifies a sustained prior state from a newly adopted standpoint. Applying the grievance-bearing label to themselves reverses the position from which they might have complained, while the temporal copula leaves the state retrospectively bounded without proving that repair is complete.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a held view or doctrine; their saying marks a revision in what they now take their own history to mean.
The branch supplies being across time; it makes the accusation retrospective rather than an unqualified essence claim.
The branch supplies grievance and a claim for redress; naming themselves reverses them from imagined claimants into those answerable to a grievance.
The branch supplies correction toward completion; it keeps a repaired future structurally possible after the retrospective diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: The clause is a timeless self-condemnation.
changed_reading.after: The clause is a retrospective reclassification of a former state, opening but not guaranteeing movement from grievance-causer toward correction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's writing frame distinguishes an aligned record from fabricated story, while the focus supplies an articulated counterstatement. The owners' confession can be heard as oral testimony that corrects the kind of false inscription their earlier worldview would have produced.

activation_trace.role: The branch gives voiced articulation; the confession enters the public field rather than remaining an inner realization.
The branch gives the trimmed writing implement; it supplies the material act by which an account can be fixed.
The branch gives ordered written rows; it frames truthful articulation as something aligned and retainable.
The branch gives fabricated tales; it supplies the rival mode of recording that dismisses signs instead of learning from them.
The branch gives false assertion or attribution; its earlier speech act is reversed by the focus group's truthful self-attribution.

structural_cues: 68:1 opens with writing and aligned rows, while 68:15 joins saying to the charge of fabricated stories.
68:29 uses direct plural speech and an emphatic nominal accusation, giving the correction testimonial force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, fabricated stories, and two opposed sayings; I infer that the focus saying functions as a corrective oral record. A live alternative is a looser speech-versus-writing resonance with no testimonial function.

changed_reading.before: The confession is a transient exclamation inside the garden story.
changed_reading.after: The confession also acts as a counter-record, replacing false attribution with a durable self-indicting account.

context_deltas.mechanism: A context field of denial, smoothing compromise, tale-bearing, withholding, false speech, and lowered voices makes the bare `they said` highly marked. The same collective that coordinated exclusion in secrecy now speaks openly and directs accusation toward itself.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies overt articulation; it makes the plural confession the public reversal of covert coordination.
The branch supplies imputing falsehood to a thing or speaker; it establishes the surah's corrupted attributional speech.
The branch supplies pliant accommodation; it marks speech that smooths over truth for reciprocal convenience.
The branch supplies speech carried outward as malicious report; it contrasts with outward speech that indicts the speakers themselves.
The branch supplies a hand withheld from giving; it links corrupt social speech to the owners' eventual diagnosis of blocked good.
The branch supplies saying what is not so; the focus saying reverses that pattern by assigning fault where it belongs.
The branch supplies deliberately lowered utterance; it is the covert channel that the audible confession breaks open.

structural_cues: 68:8-15 catalogs social and verbal corruption before the garden narrative.
68:23 places the owners' exclusion plan in hushed reciprocal speech, whereas 68:29 gives an unqualified plural declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corrupt speech types and the owners' whispering; I infer a secrecy-to-publicity reversal in `they said`. The live alternative is that both verbs are ordinary narrative speech tags and only their contents contrast.

changed_reading.before: Their words merely disclose remorse to the reader.
changed_reading.after: Their words reverse their prior speech practice: covert coordination and displaced accusation become open collective self-accusation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden event functions as an assay that makes an already present condition visible. Their settled trust while asleep sharpens the contrast: the loss does not create `we were wrongdoers`; it removes the cover under which that prior state could remain unnamed.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a condition present through time; it anchors the exposed wrong before the moment of recognition.
The branch supplies misplaced or mistimed action; this is the latent condition the test renders legible.
The branch supplies an assay in which a condition appears; it makes the garden episode diagnostic rather than merely destructive.
The branch supplies repose through trust in something; their sleep embodies confidence in a plan whose moral state remains unexamined.

structural_cues: 68:17 explicitly compares this testing with another testing.
The destructive visitation occurs while the owners sleep, and the focus uses a past-state copula only after they see the result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, unwary trust, loss, and a retrospective state clause; I infer that consequence reveals rather than manufactures the wrong. A live alternative is a strictly punitive sequence in which the event answers conduct without exposing a latent identity.

changed_reading.before: The confession is remorse caused by a sudden loss.
changed_reading.after: The loss is an assay that exposes and names a condition already operating before the garden was struck.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owners bind themselves to cut the produce, move before others can arrive, whisper a no-entry rule, and treat practical capacity as capacity to prevent access. Against the focus branches, this converts cultivated increase into a closed circuit and identifies their `zulm` as withholding a due from those whose subsistence depends on entry.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies nurture toward completion; it frames the crop as the result of a sustaining order rather than autonomous possession.
The branch supplies withholding and prevention from a right; it gives the confession its distributive mechanism.
The branch supplies refusal to extend the giving hand; it prefigures the owners' social action as a known pattern of blocked good.
The branch supplies a binding oath distributed among its parties; it turns exclusion into a coordinated commitment.
The branch supplies harvesting by cutting; it is the material operation they schedule to preempt access.
The branch supplies accumulated work and gain; it shows what they construe as exclusively theirs to close.
The branch supplies hushed articulation; secrecy is the social seal around the planned exclusion.
The branch supplies passage into an interior; their rule specifically blocks crossing the garden boundary.
The branch supplies subsistence that lets one remain; it makes the excluded poor person's need material rather than abstract.
The branch supplies prevention and contraction; it names the exclusionary direction of their morning resolve.
The branch supplies effective capacity and control; they mistake ability to act for authorization to withhold.

structural_cues: 68:17-25 moves from oath, to omitted exception, to early departure, to whisper, to an explicit no-entry command.
The intended beneficiary is grammatically placed outside the garden boundary, while the owners describe themselves as capable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coordinated cutting, secrecy, denied entry, need, and capacity; I infer that the poor person has a due and that exclusion realizes the focus branch of withholding a right. A live alternative locates the main fault in omitted qualification and arrogant self-sufficiency rather than distributive withholding.

changed_reading.before: `We were wrongdoers` remains a broad confession after property loss.
changed_reading.after: `We were wrongdoers` precisely names the conversion of nurtured produce, practical power, and a garden boundary into a mechanism for withholding subsistence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speech sequence moves through abductive revisions: sight first yields a provisional diagnosis of being lost, then a deprivation diagnosis, then the central member recalls neglected praise, and only then does the focus clear the Lord and place fault in the self. The confession is the endpoint of corrected causal attribution.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies visual and inward seeing; the altered garden initiates diagnosis.
The branch supplies saying with the force of supposing; their first spoken account remains a revisable hypothesis.
The branch supplies loss of the sought thing; the first explanation treats the mismatch as failed location.
The branch supplies deprivation and a missed object; the second explanation still centers what has happened to them.
The branch supplies just or choice centrality; the central speaker supplies the corrective pivot in the group's reasoning.
The branch supplies absolution and distancing from defect; the recalled omission prepares the transfer of blame.
The same branch now becomes their own utterance, completing the shift from self-centered loss to divine exoneration.
The branch supplies misplacement and mistiming; the final hypothesis relocates causal error in their own ordering of action.

structural_cues: 68:26, 68:27, 68:28, and 68:29 present four consecutive diagnostic speech moves.
The object of explanation shifts from absent garden, to deprived self, to neglected praise, to prior wrongdoing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of changing statements; I infer that they form an abductive ladder whose causal attribution improves at each step. A live alternative is that different speakers voice competing reactions rather than one group-level reasoning process.

changed_reading.before: The focus confession appears as an immediate burst of remorse.
changed_reading.after: The confession is the fourth and most self-implicating hypothesis in a visible sequence of failed and corrected explanations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus briefly gathers the owners into `we`, but the next ayah decomposes that whole into parts facing and blaming one another. Collective confession is real yet socially unstable: shared words do not immediately dissolve internal accusation.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a single articulated plural act; it momentarily gives the group one voice.
The branch supplies a group turning member toward member; the collective voice becomes an interpersonal confrontation.
The branch supplies partition into portions; it breaks the confessed `we` into reciprocal sides.
The branch supplies deserved reproach; accountability continues but is redirected laterally among members.

structural_cues: 68:29 uses a unified plural subject and predicate.
68:30 immediately repeats `some ... some`, replacing unity with reciprocal blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective confession followed immediately by mutual reproach; I infer that the shared `we` is a fragile achievement rather than completed reconciliation. A live alternative is that mutual blame is itself a constructive distribution of accountability.

changed_reading.before: The plural confession signals a settled collective repentance.
changed_reading.after: The plural confession is a genuine but unstable interval of shared responsibility inside an unresolved blame process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next speech nearly repeats the focus syntax but replaces `wrongdoers` with `boundary-crossers`. The two predicates remain mutually illuminating: their act both put relations out of place and exceeded a limit through forceful self-authorization.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies displacement from proper place or time; it preserves the ordering dimension of their diagnosis.
The branch supplies a second overt declaration; its repetition asks the two predicates to be read together.
The branch supplies the same retrospective temporal frame; it formally pairs the two self-diagnoses.
The branch supplies transgressive overflow beyond a limit; it adds excessive reach to the focus image of misplacement.

structural_cues: 68:29 and 68:31 share plural saying, emphatic `inna`, past `kunna`, and an active-participle predicate.
Only the final predicate changes, preserving two diagnoses rather than canceling the first.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tight syntactic echo with a changed predicate; I infer complementary mechanisms of displacement and excess. A live alternative treats the second predicate as a near-synonymous intensification with no distinct mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Their wrong consists only in a misplaced or withheld act.
changed_reading.after: Their confession coexists with a second diagnosis: the misplacement was produced by power and desire overflowing a proper boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: After retrospectively naming their state, the speakers release the ruined object, hope for substitution from their Lord, and redirect desire toward that Lord. Confession becomes a hinge from possessive control to receptive orientation, although the wished-for `better` can still carry acquisitive ambiguity.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a past condition; it provides the temporal side from which a different future can be desired.
The branch supplies nurture, correction, and completion; repeated Lord-language makes repair depend on an agency beyond their control.
The branch supplies movement toward beneficial good; it gives the hoped-for replacement a possible ethical direction.
The branch supplies one thing standing in another's place; it converts loss from final closure into possible reordering.
The branch supplies desire oriented toward or away from an object; the stated direction turns desire toward the Lord rather than the garden.

structural_cues: 68:32 follows the two retrospective confessions with hope, substitution, and the directional phrase `to our Lord`.
`Our Lord` repeats twice after appearing once in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal confession, hoped substitution, beneficial good, and directed desire; I infer that confession enables reparative reorientation. A live alternative is that they merely want a more profitable garden, so the verse does not certify moral repair.

changed_reading.before: The confession terminates in guilt over an irrecoverable loss.
changed_reading.after: The confession can pivot from possessive control toward a different future received from and desired through the Lord, without proving that desire is purified.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later interrogatives dismantle every imagined warrant for self-serving judgment: no authoritative ruling, written charter, chosen entitlement, binding oath, guarantor, or truthful proof is produced. Against that field, the focus confession retracts an arrogated legal fiction, and `subhana rabbina` denies that their private rule came from the Lord.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies arrogated judgment over another; it exposes the owners' no-entry rule as speech pretending to authority.
The branch supplies absolution; it clears the Lord of authorship of their private entitlement.
The branch supplies actual ownership and authority; it contrasts with the speakers' unsupported exercise of rule.
The branch supplies adjudication between people; the question challenges the basis of self-favoring verdicts.
The branch supplies a written establishment that imposes a ruling; its interrogative absence removes textual warrant.
The branch supplies choosing what is preferred; the question exposes preference masquerading as entitlement.
The branch supplies oath-backed assurance; its alleged reach is tested and denied.
The branch supplies a guarantor who bears liability; the demand reveals that no one underwrites their claim.
The branch supplies truth in speech; it sets the evidentiary condition their self-authorizing claim cannot meet.

structural_cues: 68:35-41 is a chain of forensic questions about equal treatment, judgment, books, selections, oaths, guarantors, partners, and truth.
The owners' earlier `no one shall enter` has the grammatical force of a rule but no displayed warrant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later audit of warrants and the focus supplies authority, absolution, and self-accusation; I infer that the confession retracts a private legal fiction. A live alternative is that 68:35-41 addresses a broader opponent class and does not specifically reactivate the garden owners' rule.

changed_reading.before: They admit that a selfish plan was morally wrong.
changed_reading.after: They also withdraw an unsupported jurisdiction: their power and preference never constituted a Lord-backed right to decide who may receive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene separates being summoned to lower oneself from having the capacity to do so. This reactivates the focus formula as more than correct content: spoken praise and self-lowering may be a verbal analogue of bodily prostration while that responsive capacity remains available.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies voiced performance; it lets the formula operate as an enacted response rather than a silent belief.
The branch supplies worship and prayer through praise; it gives the utterance ritual force.
The branch supplies exposure of what was concealed or defective; the later summons tests whether response can still become action.

structural_cues: 68:42-43 places summons, inability, lowered eyes, humiliation, and a prior period of bodily soundness in one sequence.
68:29 performs praise and self-accusation verbally but names no bodily gesture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ritual praise, bodily lowering, capacity, and later incapacity; I infer a functional analogy between confession and prostration. A live alternative is that the focus remains purely verbal, since no bodily act is stated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pattern of being taken degree by degree, given time, and handled through a firm design makes the focus's retrospective `we were` temporally dense. Their sentence compresses a condition that persisted while its consequence and meaning were still hidden from them.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies occurrence extended in past time; it anchors the confession in duration rather than a single bad instant.
The branch supplies disclosure to a knower; its negation marks the actors' lack of access to the process governing them.
The branch supplies taking by successive degrees; it provides a staged arrow from hidden condition to visible reckoning.
The branch supplies extended time and respite; duration allows the unrecognized condition to continue before disclosure.
The branch supplies forceful handling of a matter; it makes the eventual exposure part of an active process rather than accident.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 combines lack of knowledge, staged movement, respite, and a firm first-person design.
The focus's past copula retrospectively gathers a period that the owners did not correctly understand while living through it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden staged action and prolonged time; I infer that `we were` summarizes an unrecognized trajectory later made visible. A live alternative is that 68:44-45 concerns other deniers and should not determine the garden episode's timescale.

changed_reading.before: `We were wrongdoers` points back to one exclusionary decision.
changed_reading.after: `We were wrongdoers` can summarize a longer hidden trajectory whose meaning became visible only when the process reached consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later companion narrative moves from imminent exposed blame through the Lord's catching favor to selection and placement among the sound. It reactivates `our Lord` as corrective agency and `we were` as a state that may be transformed, while offering no guarantee that the garden owners receive the same outcome.

68:29 likewise follows perceptual shock but assigns defect to the speakers rather than to the Lord or another person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two destabilization-and-speech sequences; I infer that they model divergent responses to unwelcome disclosure. A live alternative is that their shared shape is incidental because the final opponents are not narratively linked to the garden owners.

changed_reading.before: The confession is one local reaction to a ruined garden.
changed_reading.after: The confession models the receptive branch of destabilization: reminder becomes self-correction, whereas resisted reminder becomes concealment and false accusation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant `q-w-l` to `q-l-l` mapping, so it is form-distant and must not replace the ordinary sense of saying. It remains anchored in the focus verb and gains contextual support from loss of footing; downstream prose should present it only as an acoustic-affective image of confession shaken loose.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The activation attaches to the focus verb `qalu` and colors the manner in which the plural utterance emerges.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch supplies rattling and unstable movement; it colors the saying as speech produced after certainty has been shaken.
The branch supplies slipping from a station and inability to keep footing; it contextualizes destabilization as a precondition for changed speech.

changed_reading.before: `They said` is a stable and transparent report of speech.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory affective level, their saying is speech rattled loose when their moral and material footing fails.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading activates the packet's non-dominant `r-b-b` to `r-b-w` mapping and its transactional-surplus branch, so it is a cross-root resonance rather than a lexical gloss of `rabbina`. It remains anchored in the focus Lord-word and the story's wealth-harvest economy; downstream prose should qualify it as an exploratory critique of surplus logic.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The activation attaches to `rabbina`, where the speakers clear the Lord while abandoning their own extractive claim.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch supplies surplus extracted in exchange; it exposes a rival economic logic from which `our Lord` is being cleared.
The branch supplies withheld right; it links surplus retention to the self-accusation without redefining lordship.
The branch supplies accumulation and abundance of wealth; it establishes the wider context in which possession can authorize excess.
The branch supplies acquired gain and labor; it grounds the owners' surplus-seeking in the actual harvest economy.

changed_reading.before: `Our Lord` is only a devotional title inside remorse.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, `our Lord` marks a reversal from self-authorized surplus extraction toward a lordship cleared of the owners' withholding economy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses a rare plant branch of the focus root, so it is imagistic and cannot stand as the lexical meaning of `zalimin`. It remains anchored in that predicate and is materially activated by the garden's dense growth and planned cutting; downstream prose should mark it as an ecological-social analogy of excess beyond a sustaining base.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The activation attaches directly to `zalimin` and renders their wrongdoing as growth that extends beyond its proper base.

activation_trace.role: The rare branch supplies a tree whose long shoots overspread its base; it images social and possessive reach exceeding the order that supports it.
The branch supplies intertwined, surging vegetation; it gives the excess-growth image a concrete garden medium.
The branch supplies severance and separation; planned cutting becomes the material endpoint of an ownership logic that has overextended.
The branch supplies governed nurture toward completion; it provides the sustaining base against which overshooting growth is diagnosed.

changed_reading.before: Their wrongdoing is an abstract moral property attached to the owners.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological image, their wrongdoing is possessive growth whose shoots outrun the nurturing base and turn harvest into severance.

strongest_changes: The focus confession becomes the final step in an abductive ladder from apparent mislocation, to felt deprivation, to remembered praise, to self-attributed wrongdoing.
`Zalimin` becomes mechanically specific: the owners used oath, secrecy, timing, boundary, and capacity to withhold access to subsistence produced within a nurturing order.
The plural saying reverses a wider corrupt-speech field, yet the immediate return to mutual blame keeps collective repentance socially unfinished.
The syntactic echo in 68:31 preserves two coexisting diagnoses: misplacement or withholding and transgressive overflow beyond a limit.
The past-state wording remains open to repair under lordship, but neither hoped replacement nor the later repair analogy proves that these speakers are transformed.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made one short confession behave as attributional transfer, public counter-speech, distributive diagnosis, temporal reclassification, and a fragile collective act. Split-root branches also preserved live but contained images of shaken speech, surplus extraction, and growth overshooting its base.
remaining_uncertainties: The poor person's enforceable due is inferred from exclusion, subsistence, and withholding branches rather than explicitly stated in the focus ayah.
The consecutive speeches may represent different speakers rather than one collective reasoning sequence.
The wish for a better replacement can indicate reparative orientation or continued acquisitiveness.
Later judgment, prostration, gradual disclosure, and companion-repair scenes may reactivate the garden confession structurally without referring to its speakers directly.
The non-dominant and rare-branch outliers are packet-licensed resonances, not proposed lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Purification of the Lord from their attribution.** `س ب ح B002` supplies declaring free from evil, `ر ب ب B001/B002` authority and nurture, and `ك و ن B001` their past state. Their speech reverses the earlier ownership-centered plan. I infer recognition of a governing order -> removal of blame from that order; *subḥāna rabbinā* relocates fault before they name themselves.
2. **Confession as withholding and misplacement.** For `ظ ل م`, accepted `B008` supplies prevention/withholding and `B004` concrete misplacement or mistiming. Both are activated by their attempt to withhold good and to make the morning serve an exclusionary plan. I infer the event reveals those acts as wrongly placed use of property and time; “we were wrongdoers” becomes a diagnostic confession tied to packet-visible conduct.
3. **Speech now corresponds to inward state.** `ق و ل B001/B012` holds uttered and inner saying together. The plural confession follows the balanced member's prompt rather than their former whisper. I infer collective recognition -> public articulation; the ayah reverses hidden coordination into shared acknowledgment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:30 shows that confession does not instantly end social friction; mutual blame follows before 68:31 reaches the broader category of transgressive excess. 68:32 then demonstrates a constructive effect of confession by reorienting hope and desire.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wrongdoing as a plan put in the wrong time and place.** Fixed `ظَالِمِينَ` activates `ظ ل م B004` (doing something at the wrong concrete time or place). The “today” and garden-entry restriction in 68:24, followed by failed recognition and deprivation in 68:26-27, supply coordinates and result; I infer that the confession now recognizes the logistics of exclusion as misplacement, not only an abstract moral quality. Their chosen occasion and garden become evidence inside the word “wrongdoers.”
2. **Purification relocates agency and reopens nurture.** Fixed `سُبْحَانَ` activates `س ب ح B002` (declaring free), and fixed `رَبِّنَا` activates `ر ب ب B002` (nurture and repair). The warning in 68:28 and hope for replacement in 68:32 supply correction and renewed cultivation; I infer that absolving the Lord of their scheme allows lordly nurture to be recognized as the source of any future yield. The utterance changes from blame-avoidance to a repaired causal model: fault lies with their action, growth with their Lord.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:32's hope for Lord-given change showed that the purification in fixed `سُبْحَانَ` had repaired the causal model rather than ended in confession. 68:34's gardens of ease further sharpened fixed `رَبِّنَا` as renewed nurture (`ر ب ب B002`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Middle Voice Mediates Confession and Reorientation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A central participant occupies a just mediating position, recalls omitted worship, and redirects the group toward exoneration and redress.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: just and best center (`quranic:root_001646:B001/m01`); spatial middle (`quranic:root_001646:B002/m01`); entry into the middle (`quranic:root_001646:B003/m01`); mediation between parties (`quranic:root_001646:B005/m01`); worship and thanksgiving (`quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`); exoneration from wrong (`quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`); sincere care in speech (`quranic:root_001272:B015/m01`); grievance and request for justice (`quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`); withholding another’s right (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:28 `أَوْسَطُ` [و س ط], `تُسَبِّحُ` [س ب ح], and `قَالَ`/`أَقُل` [ق و ل]; 68:29 `سُبْحَٰنَ` [س ب ح] and `ظَٰلِمِينَ` [ظ ل م].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: “The middle one” is both a location and a social function. Mediation interrupts mutual blame, and exonerating God permits the group to relocate wrong in its own withheld rights and conduct.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 68:17-33] Excess Crosses Its Limit and Returns as Overwhelming Force
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What rises beyond measure becomes a material or political overflow whose return is loss, domination, or punishment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral excess shares a shape with floodwater, raised terrain, tyrannical rule, and a burden too large to carry; judgment is the reversal of uncontrolled magnitude.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Transgression Behaves Like Floodwater
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Conduct exceeds its channel as water rises above its banks, sweeps material away, and deposits it where it does not belong.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: crossing the limit in rebellion (`quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`); surging water or force (`quranic:root_000937:B002/m01`); rebellious excess (`quranic:root_000936:B001/m01`); flooding water or blood (`quranic:root_000936:B002/m01`); action put in the wrong place or time (`quranic:root_000967:B004/m01`); growth extending beyond its origin (`quranic:root_000967:B007/m01`); rights withheld (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:29 `ظَٰلِمِينَ` [ظ ل م]; 68:31 `طَٰغِينَ` [ط غ ي]; surface anchor unavailable for root `ط غ و`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Excess is given hydraulic shape. It rises, exceeds its channel, and relocates material improperly, making “we were transgressors” a diagnosis of uncontrolled flow as well as unlawful conduct.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 68:17-33] Loss Reorients Desire Toward Replacement and Repair
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: After deprivation, hope becomes a directed search for a substitute that restores function and exceeds the lost provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Replacement is not a reset: it can change only outward form, occupy another’s place, restore a depleted flow, or answer desire with a more generous provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Directed Desire Seeks a More Generous Provision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Desire turns toward a chosen good whose spaciousness and generosity answer the constriction of loss.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: desire directed toward or away (`quranic:root_000575:B001/m01`); spacious capacity (`quranic:root_000575:B002/m01`); abundant desirable gift (`quranic:root_000575:B004/m01`); beneficial good (`quranic:root_000452:B001/m02`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m02`); generosity (`quranic:root_000452:B005/m02`); hope of returning milk (`quranic:root_001015:B006/m02`); favor and need answered (`quranic:root_000532:B016/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:32 `خَيْرًا` [خ ي ر]; 68:29/32 forms of `ر ب ب` [ر ب ب]; 68:32 `عَسَىٰ` [ع س ي] and `رَٰغِبُونَ` [ر غ ب].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Desire is directional and capacious. It leaves the destroyed object, turns toward the giver, and asks not merely for equivalence but for a more spacious, generous, and durable good.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 68:17-33] Worship Redirects Blame into Redress and Giving
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Corrective speech exonerates the giver, acknowledges wrong, and restores outward movement through worship, acceptance, and generosity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Praise is not isolated ritual language; it changes the social direction of goods by replacing exclusion and self-justification with accepted fault, protected relation, and largesse.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Admission Opens a Claim for Redress
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A wronged or self-correcting party names the misplacement, accepts blame, and seeks an accepted replacement rather than defending the prior claim.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: grievance seeking justice (`quranic:root_000967:B003/m02`); wrong placement or timing (`quranic:root_000967:B004/m02`); accepted excuse or repentance (`quranic:root_001198:B004/m01`); mutual blame (`quranic:root_001386:B001/m02`); exonerating correction (`quranic:root_000666:B002/m03`); leaving or preventing a harmful course (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Confession becomes operative when it moves beyond self-reproach. Exoneration locates responsibility, acceptance receives the corrected claim, and redress directs the speakers toward a different future provision.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi söyleme fiilinin belirli dil bilgisel ortamlarda sanma fiili gibi işletilmesini anlatır. Bu dal, gerçek söz söyleme eylemi değil, bir yargı veya varsayım kuran gramatik kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dil bilgisel sanma kullanımıdır; normal söz söyleme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım özel gramatik kullanımın dışına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Söyleme fiilinin bazı yapılarda sanmak veya varsaymak gibi işleyerek sonraki unsurları ona göre kurduğu dil bilgisel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, söyleme fiilinin sanma ve varsayma işleviyle kullanılmasıdır.
Kullanım özellikle soru yapısıyla sınırlanır, fakat aktarımda daha geniş bir lehçe uygulaması da anılır.
Kaynak içindeki lehçe notu, soru dışı kullanıma da uzanan özel bir genişleme bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

source_details.summary: Tekil aktarım, sanmak gibi işleyen söyleme kullanımını ve soru dışına uzanan lehçe notunu verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Söyleme fiili gerçek konuşma değil, varsayım veya sanma yapısı kurduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gramatik işlevi ve sanma değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dil bilgisel açıklamada söyleme fiilinin varsayım değeri kazandığı bağlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sanma işlevini ve kullanım açıklamasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda epistemik zayıflık ve tahmin içeriği merkezdir; bu dalda dil bilgisel işleyiş merkezdir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.

branches.source_phrase_ar: العرب تجري تقول وحدها في الاستفهام مجرى تظن في العمل (sihah)؛ بنو سليم يجرون متصرف قلت في غير الاستفهام أيضا مجرى الظن (sihah)

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yolculuk yüklerini alarak bulunduğu yerden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yükü taşıma eyleminden çok onu taşıyacak güce sahip olmayı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Taşıma yeterliği ortak olsa da bu kol fiilî taşıma ve yerden yükselme yönlerine açılır; komşu kol güç yetirme sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yük üstlenmeyi, kuşun havalanmasını ve yolcuların yüklenerek ayrılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kişinin oturduğu yerden kalkmasını ve bir nesneyi bulunduğu yerden kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aşağıdaki veya durağan bir konumdan kalkma ve hareket başlangıcını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yükselmeyi taşıma ve yolculukla bağlar; komşu kol bedensel olarak ayağa kalkma ve nesneyi yerinden kaldırma çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda yolculuk anlamı yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılmasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد القلة العددية، ولا قلة الجبل، ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقل الجرة أطاق حملها؛ استقلت السماء ارتفعت؛ استقل القوم مضوا وارتحلوا (sihah)؛ أقل الرجل الشيء واستقله إذا احتمله؛ استقل الطائر إذا نهض للطيران؛ استقل النبات أناف؛ استقل القوم إذا احتملوا ظاعنين؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي حملت؛ قل إذا رفع وقل إذا علا (tahdhib)؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي احتملته؛ أقللت كذا وجدته قليل المحمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, çekirdeği Tanrı'yı yüceltme ve anma olan sözlü, eylemsel veya niyete dayalı kullukta birleştirir; dua ve gönüllü anma bunun belirgin gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yüzme, koşma, ışık, boncuk ya da giysi anlamlarını değil, yüceltmeye dayalı kulluk eylemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım belirli bir kalıba bağlanmadan dua, anma, şükür ve genel kulluk alanını korur.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'yı yüceltmek ve anmak üzere sözle, eylemle veya niyetle yerine getirilen kulluktur. Dua, gönüllü anma ve şükür bu çekirdeğin başlıca gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Söz, eylem veya niyet yoluyla Tanrı'yı yüceltmeye ve anmaya yönelen kulluk.
Dua ile gönüllü anma ve şükür, bu kulluğun belirgin uygulama biçimleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı dua ve anmayla sınırlamadan Tanrı'yı yücelten sözlü, eylemsel ve niyete dayalı kulluk ekseninde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın söz, eylem ve niyeti kapsayan genel kulluk çekirdeği için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüceltme, anma ve kulluk bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dua ile gönüllü anmanın özellikle öne çıktığı kullanım bağlamlarına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dua ve anma yoluyla yapılan kulluğu açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Söz dışındaki eylem ve yalnızca niyet düzeyindeki genel kulluk kapsamını daraltır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülük ve eksiklikten uzak sayma çekirdeğini ortak biçimde verir; yüceltici kalıp, genel eylem ve Tanrısal niteleme bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal kulluk eyleminin bütünü değil, Tanrı'nın kötülükten ve eksiklikten uzak olduğunu bildiren yargı ve nitelemeleri kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem ve niteleme ile kalıplaşmış sözler birlikte bulunur; kalıpların şaşma veya ilişiksiz sayma işlevi genel çekirdeğe yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülükten, kusurdan ve kendisine yakışmayan nitelikten uzak sayarak yüceltmedir. Belirli söz kalıplarında bu uzak tutma, şaşma veya bir iddiadan ilişiksiz sayma işlevi de kazanır.

facets.statement: Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülük ve eksiklikten uzak sayıp yüceltme.
Tanrı için kullanılan bir niteleme, onun kendisine yakışmayan her şeyden uzak olduğunu belirtir.
Belirli bir söz kalıbı, şaşma ya da bir kişiyi veya şeyi öne sürülen iddiadan uzak tutma bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi, yönetim ve düzenleme çekirdeğini destekler. Bununla birlikte yalın ve mutlak kullanım Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insanlar ve nesneler için anlam, sahip olunan ya da yönetilen şeyin belirtilmesine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim ile ev, hayvan veya başka bir şey üzerinden kurulan tamlamalar aynı kapsamda değildir; tanım bu kullanım koşulunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık ya da şey üzerinde sahiplik, üstün yetke ve düzenleyici yönetim kurma niteliğidir. Mutlak kullanım Tanrı'yı gösterirken başka kullanımlar yönetilen veya sahip olunan şeyi açıkça belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir yere bağlanıp oradan ayrılmama çekirdeğini insan, deve ve bulut için destekler; süreklilik ve yaklaşma anlamları da kalıcılık eksenine bağlı yan gelişmelerdir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İnsan için yerleşik kalma alanında güçlü biçimde örtüşürler; odak dal aynı çekirdeği hava olaylarına, hayvan davranışına ve yaklaşmaya genişletir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس السحاب نفسه إذا سمي ربابا، ولا شاة رُبّى خاصة
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب بالمكان وأرب إذا أقام به (jamhara); مرب الإبل حيث لزمته؛ أربت الإبل؛ أربت الناقة؛ أربت الجنوب والسحابة أي دامت؛ الأرباب الدنو (sihah); أرب فلان بالمكان إذا أقام به فلم يبرحه؛ مرب الإبل أي حيث لزمته (tahdhib); أربت السحابة: دامت؛ أرب فلان بمكان كذا (mufradat); الأصل الآخر لزوم الشيء والإقامة عليه؛ أربت السحابة؛ الإرباب الدنو (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bulutun yapısını ve konumunu anlatır; renk ile yağmur veya bitki yetiştirme sonucu zorunlu tanım öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Parçaları birbirine binmiş ya da başka bulutların altında asılı duran bulut kümesidir; beyaz veya siyah olabilir.

facets.statement: Bulut parçaları üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran belirgin bir küme oluşturur.
Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda öne çıkar, ancak renk bütün kullanımlar için sabit değildir.
Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran bulut yapısında birleşir; renk konusunda beyazlık ile renk değişkenliği arasında fark bulunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bulutun parçalı, üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı yapısını anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut olma, katmanlaşma ve asılı durma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulut parçalarının birbirine binerek bir küme oluşturduğu görünüm için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bulutun katmanlı ve birleşik yapısını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: beyaz olabilen, katmanlı veya aşağıda asılı bulut

error_profile.preserves: Bulut ve yağışla ilişki yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Yağmur taşıma zorunluluğu ekler ve katmanlı ya da asılı yapı sınırını belirsizleştirir.
error_profile.collision: Her yağmur bulutunun bu özel yapıda olduğu izlenimini doğurur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutun parçalarının üst üste binmesi veya başka bulutların altında asılı durması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Su yüklü olma, siyahlık ve göksel burçla ilişki komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirgin ve yoğun bir bulut oluşumunu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapısal katmanlaşma ve asılı konumla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise su taşıma, koyu renk ve göksel işaret ilişkisini öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bulut türleri arasında yapısal sınırı en açık gösteren aday seçildi, doğrudan yağmur veya mevsimsel yağış bildiren adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر

branches.source_phrase_ar: الرباب: سحاب أبيض؛ الواحدة ربابة (sihah); الربابة: السحابة التي قد ركب بعضها بعضا؛ جمعها رباب (tahdhib); الرباب: السحاب، سمي بذلك لأنه يرب النبات (mufradat); سمي السحاب ربابا؛ السحاب المتعلق دون السحاب يكون أبيض ويكون أسود (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, yakın zamanda gerçekleşmişlik, tazelik ve başlangıç evresi çekirdeğini destekler. Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun özel bir uygulama, gençliğin başlangıcı ise insan yaşamına taşınmış bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun, tazelik ve gençliğin başlangıcı aynı düzeyde bağımsız çekirdekler değil; ilk durum genel yenilik sınırının özel gerçekleşmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun ve gençliğin başlangıcı gibi bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; bunlar her yalın biçime sınırsızca genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin henüz başlangıcında, yeni ve taze olmasıdır. Yeni doğurmuş koyun ile gençliğin ilk dönemi bu yakın zamanlılık niteliğinin özel uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Temel nitelik yakın zamanda başlamış olma, yenilik ve tazeliktir.
Yeni doğurmuş veya süt için evde tutulan koyun, doğum sonrası yenilik durumunu taşır.
Gençliğin ilk evresi, başlangıç ve tazelik çekirdeğinin insan yaşamına genişlemesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yeni doğurmuş koyunu, bir şeyin ilk ve taze dönemini ve gençliğin başlangıcını yakın zamanda başlamış olma ortaklığında toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlık veya dönemin henüz yeni başlamış ve taze olduğu genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıç, yenilik ve tazelik öğelerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğumun üzerinden az zaman geçmiş veya sütü için evde tutulan koyun ve keçi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın doğum sonrası yakın zamanlı durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan yaşamında gençliğin yeni başladığı dönemi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Gençlik döneminin başlangıç ve tazelik niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yeni doğurmuş veya sütü için evde tutulan koyun
bir şeyin yeni ve taze dönemi

error_profile.loses: Genel yenilik ve tazelik ile yeni doğurmuş hayvan kapsamını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun odak dalın özel kullanım alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genç kişi ve başlangıç durumundaki çok çeşitli nesneler komşu dalda daha geniş biçimde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin başlangıçta, yakın zamanlı ve taze olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel yenilik alanında örtüşürler; odak dal doğum sonrası koyun ve gençliğin ilk dönemiyle belirginleşirken komşu dal yaş ve nesne bakımından daha geniştir.
